message.text: package `feature-manifest-messy-fixture` feature `public-api`: public feature enables private feature `internal`, which may surprise downstream users.
package `feature-manifest-messy-fixture` feature `serde`: feature metadata needs a non-empty `description`.
package `feature-manifest-messy-fixture` feature `undocumented`: feature is defined in `[features]` but missing metadata; add an entry under `[package.metadata.feature-manifest]`.
package `feature-manifest-messy-fixture` feature `undocumented`: feature metadata needs a non-empty `description`.
package `feature-manifest-messy-fixture` feature `unstable`: feature is enabled by default while marked unstable, deprecated, or private; set `allow_default = true` to acknowledge the default.
package `feature-manifest-messy-fixture` feature `loop-a`: feature is part of a local cycle: loop-a -> loop-b -> loop-a.
package `feature-manifest-messy-fixture` feature `loop-b`: feature is part of a local cycle: loop-a -> loop-b -> loop-a.
package `feature-manifest-messy-fixture` feature `legacy`: metadata exists for a feature that is not declared in `[features]`.
package `feature-manifest-messy-fixture` feature `tls`: group includes `tls-rustls` more than once.
package `feature-manifest-messy-fixture` feature `tls`: group references missing feature `missing-member`.

help.text: Add an entry under `[package.metadata.feature-manifest.features]`, or run `cargo fm sync` to scaffold TODO descriptions.

shortDescription.text: Feature exists in `[features]` but has no metadata entry.

help.text: Fill in `description` with text that explains why the feature exists.

shortDescription.text: Metadata exists but has no usable description.

help.text: Remove the feature from `default`, or set `allow_default = true` when the default is intentional.

shortDescription.text: A private, deprecated, or unstable feature is default-enabled without acknowledgement.

help.text: Use local features, `dep:name`, `name/feature`, or `name?/feature` when possible.

shortDescription.text: A feature entry contains syntax that feature-manifest cannot classify.

help.text: Add the missing feature, make the dependency optional, switch to `dep:name`, or remove the stale reference.

shortDescription.text: A feature enables a plain name that is neither a declared feature nor an optional dependency.

help.text: Delete the stale metadata, re-add the feature, or run `cargo fm sync --remove-stale`.

shortDescription.text: Metadata exists for a feature that is not declared in `[features]`.

help.text: Remove the missing default member, add the feature to `[features]`, or make the referenced dependency optional.
Use local feature names in `default` when possible.

shortDescription.text: `features.default` contains syntax that feature-manifest cannot classify.

help.text: Add at least one more member or remove the group.

shortDescription.text: A group has fewer than two members.

help.text: Deduplicate the `members` array for the group.

shortDescription.text: A group repeats the same member more than once.

help.text: Remove the missing group member or add the feature to `[features]`.

shortDescription.text: A group references a feature that does not exist.

help.text: Keep at most one member of the group in the default feature set.

shortDescription.text: A mutually exclusive group has multiple default-enabled members.

help.text: Fix the dependency key, add the dependency, or remove the stale `dep:`/dependency-feature reference.

shortDescription.text: A dependency-based feature reference points at a missing dependency.

help.text: Mark the dependency `optional = true`, or use a plain dependency feature reference when the dependency is always enabled.

shortDescription.text: `dep:name` or `name?/feature` is used for a dependency that is not optional.

help.text: Make the dependency feature public too, or document why the public feature intentionally exposes that internal toggle.

shortDescription.text: A public feature enables a private feature.

help.text: Break the cycle by removing one local feature reference from the loop.
